description: Only applicable for daily quick scans or weekly quick/full scans. Randomize the start time of the scan by up to specified number of hours. For example, if a scan is scheduled for 2 p.m and randomizeScanStartTime is set to 2, the scan commences at a random time between 2 p.m and 4 p.m. Set to 0 to disable randomization.
helpText: Sets the number of hours (0–23) by which the scan start time is randomized. 0 disables randomization.
